what: A vertical-text label standing at the left screen edge changes to the name (data-name) of the section across the screen center. When the label is empty, it appears from −5px over .32s, and when no named section is at the center, it disappears toward −5px over .32s. Dark sections (data-tone="dark") when centered, the text switches to the contrast stage color
ease: Out curve mixing expo and quint half and half (site curve)

options.from: Selector for sections to watch, default [data-name] — the section’s data-name becomes the label text
options.shift: Starting distance from the left when appearing (px), default 5

note: Brackets （ ） are added with css ::before and ::after. The label is fixed to the screen (position: fixed), so the consumer leaves the section’s left margin (one column) empty

from.where: shared.js watchTitles (.tk-sectitle — picks the vertical title hidden in each section with an IntersectionObserver at rootMargin −50% (screen center) and moves it, white text over the brand story)
